messages:
harper: Heads-up: Rafa submitted notice today. Final day 2026-08-21. He's EU-based contractor converting to a full-time offer elsewhere; we need to coordinate benefits cessation, equity vesting questions, license transfers, and equipment pickup.

miguel: I can take device pickup/logistics and license transfers (Adobe, JetBrains). What's the laptop serial? Also confirm if there's an MDM unenroll to run.

sara: I'll own benefits communication + COBRA-like guidance (local EU termination rules) and final payroll reconciliation. Note: contractors don't always get COBRA; check country-specific rules.

harper: Laptop SN: RW-EU-9982. Rafa says it's company-owned. He'll be onsite next Thursday for meetings, can hand it to security. Please document shipping if needed.

miguel: For MDM unenroll we run: 
```
mdm-cli unenroll --serial RW-EU-9982 --confirm
```
I'll schedule pickup with security for 2026-08-21 afternoon. I'll also transfer JetBrains license to Miguel.TEAM before deprovision.

sara: For benefits: service ends end of month 2026-08-31. We'll send termination packet 2026-08-20 with local healthcare vendor contact, final payslip timeline, and info on any voluntary continuation options (if applicable). I'll cc payroll.

harper: Action items: 
• create offboard ticket (assign Miguel)
• confirm admin rights for 3rd-party SaaS (CI/CD, error-tracking)
• schedule exit interview (People Ops)
• confirm equity cliff/vesting with comp team (Harper)
• revoke org-level keys and transfer ownership where needed

rafa: I am sole admin on one Sentry org project and two CI pipelines. Happy to add team admins this week. Also have a personal PAT that I will rotate but please revoke org tokens on final day.

miguel: Please add new admin users now. I'll also snapshot Sentry admin list and attach to ticket. For quick revokes on last day I'll run: `gh token revoke --owner rafa` and disable user SSO.

hr-bot: Ticket HR-7110 created: "Rafa offboard (EU contractor) - devices, licenses, benefits". Assigned to Miguel. SLA initial review: 2 business days.

sara: Reminder: check equity plan docs before exit interview. If Rafa has any outstanding RSU vesting or form elections, we need comp sign-off. I'll reach out to comp.

harper: Thanks. Miguel: once device is returned and MDM unenrolled, please mark ticket DONE and include serial photo. Sara: please send termination packet on 8/20. Rafa: please schedule a 30-min exit call if you can.

rafa: Will join the exit call and add additional admin users today. Laptop will be handed to security on 8/21. Thanks for coordinating. :handshake:
